launch-ca-oakland-redwood-regional-park.needToKnow: Download the official trail map before entering. Expect roots, slopes, mud after rain, limited cell service, and junctions that require a planned return route.

launch-ca-san-jose-kelley-park.name: History Park
launch-ca-san-jose-kelley-park.summary: History Park is a 14-acre collection of original and reproduction buildings, paved streets, museums, and a weekend trolley at the south end of Kelley Park.
launch-ca-san-jose-kelley-park.hours: For 2026, grounds are listed daily 9:00 a.m.-4:00 p.m.; historic houses and museums are normally open Saturday-Sunday 12:00-3:45 p.m., subject to events and changes.
launch-ca-san-jose-kelley-park.needToKnow: Parking is off Phelan Avenue. General grounds, building interiors, trolley service, events, and admission requirements can follow different schedules.

launch-ca-san-jose-kelley-park.name: Japanese Friendship Garden
launch-ca-san-jose-kelley-park.summary: The Japanese Friendship Garden is a distinct landscaped garden within Kelley Park with ponds, bridges, and its own access conditions.
launch-ca-san-jose-kelley-park.hours: Garden access follows the currently posted City of San Jose schedule and may close independently for maintenance, water work, weather, or events.
launch-ca-san-jose-kelley-park.needToKnow: Navigate to the garden rather than the broad Kelley Park pin. Check the city notice before relying on pond conditions, bridge access, or a through-route.

launch-ca-san-jose-guadalupe-river-park.name: Guadalupe River Trail
launch-ca-san-jose-guadalupe-river-park.summary: The paved Guadalupe River Trail forms the long-distance walking and cycling spine through the downtown river park.
launch-ca-san-jose-guadalupe-river-park.hours: The trail opens one hour before sunrise and closes one hour after sunset; flooding, construction, maintenance, and emergency closures override normal access.
launch-ca-san-jose-guadalupe-river-park.needToKnow: Choose a named access point and return plan before starting. The corridor is long, crosses streets, and can be rerouted or closed after storms.

launch-ca-san-jose-guadalupe-river-park.name: Heritage Rose Garden
launch-ca-san-jose-guadalupe-river-park.summary: The free Heritage Rose Garden is a major Guadalupe Gardens destination with thousands of labeled rose varieties.
launch-ca-san-jose-guadalupe-river-park.hours: Open daily from sunrise to sunset, free of charge; maintenance, restoration work, events, and severe weather may affect individual paths.
launch-ca-san-jose-guadalupe-river-park.needToKnow: Use the Taylor Street and Seymour Street garden area rather than the downtown river pin. The closest restroom may require walking toward the Visitor Center or Rotary PlayGarden during their separate hours.

launch-ca-sacramento-william-land-region.name: Fairytale Town

launch-ca-sacramento-william-land-region.hours: Admission hours, ticketing, weather closures, and event schedules are separate from William Land Park; verify the official calendar before visiting.
launch-ca-sacramento-william-land-region.needToKnow: Navigate to the Fairytale Town entrance, not the general park address. Admission, re-entry, food, accessibility services, and special events follow attraction rules.

launch-ca-sacramento-capitol-park.name: California State Capitol Museum
launch-ca-sacramento-capitol-park.summary: The State Capitol Museum is the indoor visitor destination at the west side of Capitol Park, with security screening and separate building hours.
launch-ca-sacramento-capitol-park.hours: Open Monday-Friday 9:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m.; closed weekends and most holidays. Security or government activity can change access.
launch-ca-sacramento-capitol-park.needToKnow: There is no public visitor lot. Allow time for security screening and confirm building access separately from outdoor park access.

launch-ca-sacramento-capitol-park.name: World Peace Rose Garden
launch-ca-sacramento-capitol-park.summary: The World Peace Rose Garden is the formal rose collection and ornamental fountain area on the east side of Capitol Park.
launch-ca-sacramento-capitol-park.hours: Outdoor access follows current Capitol Park security and grounds conditions; ceremonies, maintenance, and weather can restrict paths.
launch-ca-sacramento-capitol-park.needToKnow: The central fountain is ornamental, not a splash pad. Use the east-side garden pin rather than the Capitol building entrance.

launch-ca-sacramento-capitol-park.needToKnow: Navigate to the memorial pin, keep pathways clear during ceremonies, and treat names, sculptures, and commemorative activity respectfully.

launch-ca-sacramento-capitol-park.summary: The California Firefighters Memorial is a named outdoor memorial near the Capitol in the park's east-side monument area.
launch-ca-sacramento-capitol-park.hours: Outdoor access follows current Capitol Park security and grounds conditions; official observances can temporarily limit access.
launch-ca-sacramento-capitol-park.needToKnow: Use the exact memorial pin rather than the museum entrance and leave room for ceremonies, visitors, and commemorative items.
